dedupe_keys.name: convlstm based daily water table depth wtd predictions in the usa

description: The STARS4Water research team deposits daily water-table-depth grids for the contiguous United States from a convolutional LSTM model. Zenodo lists two ConvLSTM NetCDFs driven by ERA5 and NLDAS and a ParFlow-CONUS1 comparison NetCDF. The page states a 0.04-degree grid; filenames indicate dates from January 2003 to December 2005. All three public files are about 424 MB each under CC BY 4.0. A groundwater or drought simulation could compare its water-table response with these alternative forcing and ParFlow outputs. These are simulated estimates, not a continental well-observation network. The own page does not state vertical datum, water-depth sign convention, uncertainty, masking or all variable names. No NetCDF was downloaded or inspected, so comparable grids and the exact time-axis overlap remain unverified. The related ParFlow simulations are represented here as a reference series in the same deposit, not an executable ParFlow model.
name: ConvLSTM-based Daily Water Table Depth (WTD) Predictions in the USA
notes: G6 item G6-2320. Metadata-only draft. Simulation-use and type tags are reviewer classifications. File contents and software execution were not checked. Unknown maturity does not assert active maintenance.
